The rules are read from <t3/> by every worker alike, so a rule that exists for one provider and not another cannot happen; <t4/> fails a projection that carries a rule corpus of its own (a profile table, rule bullets, a rules, lifecycle or finish-contract heading), one whose generated content names a rule id the effective rule set does not provide (a warning instead when an older template wrote it and <t5/> would remove it), and a <t6/> that does not name <t7/>.
